status: post-hoc exploratory supplement locked before outcome execution
rationale: The parent study tested Luna/max only as a delegated worker, not as a solo owner. This supplement compares Luna/max and Luna/xhigh as solo owners at the user's request.
prompt: Complete all tasks described in the root README.md. Work autonomously, inspect the repositories, make only requested changes, and run available checks. Do not ask questions. Finish with a concise summary.

interpretation.primary: Randomized within-supplement comparison of Luna/max solo with Luna/xhigh solo.
interpretation.historical: Comparisons with parent-study Grok and Sol arms are non-concurrent descriptive comparisons, not randomized paired effects.
interpretation.selection: The supplement does not retroactively alter the parent study's preregistered operating-rule selection. Any recommendation change must be labeled post-hoc.
